proposals.before: His father Ren had been farmers for generations.
proposals.after: His father Ren's family had been farmers for generations.
proposals.reason: The Chinese 世為農 describes a hereditary family occupation; the literal English wrongly makes singular father the plural predicate farmers.

decisions.reason: The Chinese 世為農 describes a hereditary family occupation; the literal English wrongly makes singular father the plural predicate farmers. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
